svg.text: Route: /admin/purchases · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• After the trip the owner enters each resibo: one line per item, in the unit it was bought in (its market units, or g / ml / pc), with what was paid for the line; “= 6000 g” shows the
conversion. A line with 0 bought records an item that wasn't found (here the bottle). A printed expiry date can be added for packaged goods.
• Save purchase (POST /api/purchases, Administrator only) adds each item's stock, logged as a restock linked to the purchase, and makes the price paid its cost per unit, so recipe costs
and food cost follow the market. Refused: a unit the item doesn't have, part of a piece, a future date, a price with nothing bought, or a dish (its stock is its raw materials). A
purchase isn't edited afterwards; a mistake is corrected with Adjust.

g.text: Record the market trip (from the shopping list)
